title: Marras 2001: csa fibre corrected of paraspinal / lumbar extensor mass at max_level (M, supine)

imaging.modality: MRI 1.5 T Philips GyroScan, T1 spin echo
imaging.plane: transverse slices perpendicular to the scan table through approximate vertebral body centres T8-S1; areas then fibre-angle corrected (dot product with literature fibre directions)

quantity.name: csa_fibre_corrected
quantity.definition: anatomical CSA multiplied by cosine of fibre angle to the plane normal (authors may call it PCSA/physiological area; NOT volume/fibre-length PCSA); largest fibre-angle-corrected ACSA over levels T8-S1 for each subject (authors call it "PCSA"; it is NOT volume/fibre-length PCSA)

source.authors: Marras WS, Jorgensen MJ, Granata KP, Wiand B
source.sample: young healthy volunteers (same 30 subjects/MRI scans as Jorgensen 2001)

how_to_simulate: For each transverse level T8-S1 sum the PCSA of er. spinae fascicles crossing that level (one side).
Take the maximum over levels and compare with the measured mean +/- SD (or compare whole-muscle PCSA, noting the measured value underestimates true PCSA for short-fibred multi-segment muscles).

subject_model.source: Table 1 (vertebral body ACSA by level in Table 2, e.g. L3 14.13 cm2)

protocol.notes: Table 3 "PCSA" = maximum corrected ACSA across levels. Converted cm2 -> mm2.

extraction.check_notes: Values compared with Table 3 text and page 42.
